# netbox_device (Resource)

Manages a NetBox device (`/api/dcim/devices/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_manufacturer" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device_type" "example" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.example.id
  model           = "example"
  slug            = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device_role" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_site" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.example.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_type_id` (Number) ID of the Device Type (`netbox_device_type`).
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the Device Role (`netbox_device_role`).
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the Site (`netbox_site`).

### Optional

- `airflow` (String) Airflow. Valid values: `front-to-rear`, `rear-to-front`, `left-to-right`, `right-to-left`, `side-to-rear`, `rear-to-side`, `bottom-to-top`, `top-to-bottom`, `passive`, `mixed`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `asset_tag` (String) A unique tag used to identify this device.
- `cluster_id` (Number) ID of the Cluster (`netbox_cluster`).
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `config_template_id` (Number) ID of the Config Template (`netbox_config_template`).
- `cooling_method` (String) Cooling Method. Valid values: `air`, `liquid`, `hybrid`, `immersion`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `face` (String) Face. Valid values: `front`, `rear`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `latitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy).
- `local_context_data` (String) Local config context data takes precedence over source contexts in the final rendered config context.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the Location (`netbox_location`).
- `longitude` (Number) GPS coordinate in decimal format (xx.yyyyyy).
- `name` (String) Name.
- `oob_ip_id` (Number) ID of the Ip Address (`netbox_ip_address`).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `platform_id` (Number) ID of the Platform (`netbox_platform`).
- `position` (Number) Position.
- `primary_ip4_id` (Number) ID of the Ip Address (`netbox_ip_address`).
- `primary_ip6_id` (Number) ID of the Ip Address (`netbox_ip_address`).
- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the Rack (`netbox_rack`).
- `serial` (String) Chassis serial number, assigned by the manufacturer. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `offline`, `active`, `planned`, `staged`, `failed`, `inventory`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `vc_position` (Number) Vc Position.
- `vc_priority` (Number) Virtual chassis master election priority.
- `virtual_chassis_id` (Number) ID of the Virtual Chassis (`netbox_virtual_chassis`).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_device can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_device.example 123
```
